summary.scope: Complete staged result for this finite read suite. The approved missing-readable-memory ERROR class counts as expected; not all ERROR classes do. Primary universal verification is reused separately.

metrics.timing_scope: Execution measurements reused from unchanged source/input hashes plus a fresh fully metered gpt-6.1-sol ITP run. All model, compilation and independent kernel work in this run counted once. The older unmetered authoring run remains historical and is not retroactively assigned these costs.
metrics.memory_scope: Maximum process resident memory across sequential stages: Linux GNU time %M for Coq and observed Windows process PeakWorkingSet for model client. Remote service/GPU memory excluded; not aggregate simultaneous process-tree RSS.
metrics.sharing_policy: One shared ITP model call, common helper compilation and kernel replay counted once for the batch; no multiplication or arbitrary per-case allocation.
metrics.reuse_scope: The checked concrete-heap helper is reused, recompiled and counted. All 36 refutation/entry statements were freshly completed by the metered model; previous refutation solutions were not supplied.
